texto.es: Nos cuentas qué necesitas: madera, cerámica, vinilo, laminado o una remodelación de baño o escalera. Llama al (386) 931-8663.
texto.en: Tell us what you need: hardwood, tile, vinyl, laminate, or a bathroom or stair remodel. Call (386) 931-8663.

texto.es: Vamos a tu casa en Jacksonville, tomamos medidas exactas y te damos un estimado del proyecto.
texto.en: We come to your home in Jacksonville, take exact measurements and give you an estimate for the project.

texto.es: Cada pieza se corta y se ajusta en su lugar, explicándote cada paso del proceso mientras avanzamos.
texto.en: Every piece is cut and fitted into place, explaining each step of the process as we go.

texto.es: Dejamos el área de trabajo limpia cada día y revisamos el resultado contigo antes de dar por terminado.
texto.en: We leave the work area clean every day and walk the finished result with you before calling it done.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza según el material y el área a trabajar. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on material and square footage. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Instalación de madera clavada y sólida, además de lijado y refinado de pisos existentes.
texto.en: Nailed and solid hardwood installation, plus sanding and refinishing of existing floors.

texto.es: De tina a ducha walk-in, tile hasta el techo, nichos y reforma completa de superficies.
texto.en: Tub-to-walk-in-shower conversions, floor-to-ceiling tile, niches and full surface remodels.

texto.es: Instalación de cerámica en patrón espigado, duchas y pisos, con acabados precisos.
texto.en: Herringbone tile patterns, showers and floors, installed with precise, clean finishes.

texto.es: Instalación y reparación de piso de vinilo (LVT) y laminado en cocinas y áreas de alto tránsito.
texto.en: Installation and repair of vinyl plank (LVT) and laminate flooring in kitchens and high-traffic areas.

pie.es: ¿Tienes otro tipo de piso o una reparación puntual? Pregunta igual, si tiene que ver con pisos, es trabajo para nosotros.
pie.en: Have another flooring type or a one-off repair? Ask anyway, if it involves floors, it is our kind of job.

items.quote: Vander did an amazing job on my floors! He was professional, reliable, and really paid attention to detail. Everything turned out beautiful, and I'm so happy with the finished result. He made the whole process easy from start to finish. I would absolutely recommend Vander to anyone looking for quality flooring work! As a realtor I'll be recommending him to clients as well.

Vander recently repaired our bathroom shower. He did an excellent job! During the entire process, he explained what he was doing, why he was doing it, and what caused the problem. I really appreciated being kept up to date and gaining an understanding of the process. He also repaired several vinyl planks in our kitchen and again explained everything! Highly recommend him!
Vander did such an amazing job with our floors. His attention to detail and efficiency was remarkable. I would definitely recommend him to anyone who needs flooring work :)
